description: Cheapest one-way flights between two cities, or from one city to anywhere, from cached airline prices. Dates are a departure window.

date_to.description: Latest departure date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to date_from.

from.description: Departure city name, exactly as returned by search_cities.

limit.description: Maximum number of flights to return, default 20, max 50.

to.description: Arrival city name; omit to search anywhere.

name: search_flights
title: Search flights
